name: A step above: 1970 Alfa Romeo «Scalino»
description: Последний год выпуска модели с напольными педалями и оригинальным дизайном кузова со знаменитой «ступенькой» («Scalino»).

Один владелец на протяжении последних 15 лет. Автомобиль в отличном состоянии, без следов коррозии, хранился в сухом гараже и выезжал только в солнечную погоду - для поездок по выходным и участия в автомобильных выставках.

name: Too wide to ignore: 1991 Ferrari Testarossa
description: A well respected example of Ferrari’s legendary V12 supercar. Delivered with €10,000 in maintenance works, including oils, filters, new brake pads and a new clutch.
Regularly maintained by Motor Service, an official Ferrari partner in Modena. A Ferrari Certificato di Autenticità can be requested, subject to inspection and approval.

name: Does she deserve to be loved again? 1970 Fiat 500L
description: A true barn find, sleeping in a garage for over 10 years. With just 32,000 original kilometres, she spent her glory days with the same lady throughout the ’70s and ’80s, before quietly disappearing from the roads.
Now, this little Italian icon awaits someone willing to bring her back to life and give her a new chapter. Is she worth waking up?

name: 1990 Porsche 964
description: A classic 911 generation blending the familiar air-cooled character with updated engineering and everyday usability.
